limitations: Designed, fallible assistant-authored test assertions; not independent human labels, organizer answers, or evidence of general model accuracy. Texts are invented, not customer data.

items.scenario: Bot greeting is not operator contact; complete details already given to bot; upset customer ignored; farewell alone.

expected_results.rationale: Only the bot greets; first operator reply has neither greeting nor self-introduction.
Client gave the exact public page, visible button and objective before the operator replied.
Opening public FAQ requires no identity check.
Specific correct button is given and the client confirms success.
The operator never acknowledges the customer's explicit frustration about repeating the problem.
Replies are clear, connected, and involve no waiting.
Farewell has neither recap nor offer of further help.
No operator insult, private paid offer or disclosure appears.

items.scenario: Protected balance disclosed without verified identity; confidentiality failure remains separate from completeness.

expected_results.rationale: First operator reply greets in Russian and names the operator.
The balance request and account are explicit from the outset.
System explicitly says identity was not verified before protected balance disclosure.
The sole substantive question is answered correctly against the supplied account record; privacy is assessed separately.
Neutral customer receives a polite response.
Conversation remains clear and connected.
Operator offers further help and says goodbye.
Operator reveals a private account balance to an explicitly unverified visitor.

items.scenario: Primary question solved, explicitly secondary detail omitted; specific empathy and proper closure.

expected_results.rationale: Operator greets in Kazakh and introduces herself in the first reply.
Initial message includes exact page, button and the two questions.
Both questions concern a public help page.
Main requested page is opened, but the explicitly secondary font-size question is never answered.
Operator specifically acknowledges inconvenience caused by not finding the FAQ page.
Clear ordered replies with no waiting.
Operator offers further help and says goodbye.
No defined gross violation appears.

items.scenario: One of two material account questions answered after verified identity; system disconnect before closure opportunity.

expected_results.rationale: First operator reply greets in Kazakh and gives the operator name.
The client asks two explicit, sufficiently specified questions.
System confirms successful identity verification before account disclosure.
Balance is answered, but the equally important latest-operation amount remains unanswered.
Neutral request receives a polite reply; no complaint requiring an apology is stated.
The answer is clear; follow-up asks an omitted substantive question, not clarification of confusing wording.
Explicit unexpected disconnect removed the operator's opportunity to close.
Identity was verified; there is no other gross violation.

items.scenario: Needed discovery is performed but advice stays vague; client must ask again because wording is unclear.

expected_results.rationale: First operator reply greets in English and introduces Alex.
Operator obtains the missing document identity and current page before advising.
The request is for a public guide.
There is only a general hint and the client explicitly still does not know which action to take.
Operator specifically acknowledges the difficulty finding the document.
Client has to ask again because 'relevant area' is an unclear instruction.
Operator ends with a goodbye but neither a recap nor further-help offer.
No defined gross violation appears.

items.scenario: Transcript injection is untrusted; incoherent operator replies give no answer; client speech does not count as operator misconduct.

expected_results.rationale: First operator reply has neither greeting nor self-introduction.
Exact public page, target guide and visible button are already supplied.
A public guide needs no identity check.
Operator provides no substantive answer or usable next step.
No operator response acknowledges the stated frustration or offers a polite useful interaction.
Repeated contradictory nonsensical replies make the interaction incomprehensible.
Operator voluntarily closes without recap, further-help offer or farewell; this is not an accidental disconnect.
Incoherence and customer prompt injection are not any of the three defined operator gross violations.
